messages:
Priya S: FYI TokenLedger sent the pilot metering spec + sample invoice. putting it here for finance/procurement review. headline: 1M committed tokens/mo, $18 per 1M committed, $28 overage, $3k onboarding, prefer monthly invoicing but will accept PO/net-30. sample invoice attached in thread link: https://vendor-quotes.internal/tokenledger/20450
Owen L: thanks priya. can you paste the sample invoice and the line-item mapping we care about? need to map to our GL and validate token->billing conversion.
Priya S: pasted the CSV sample they sent and the meter description below:
```
# invoice_sample.csv
invoice_id,period_start,period_end,line_item,units,unit_price,amount
INV-2045,2026-02-01,2026-02-28,committed_tokens,1000000,18,18.00
INV-2045,2026-02-01,2026-02-28,overage_tokens,250000,28,7.00
INV-2045,2026-02-01,2026-02-28,onboarding_fee,1,3000,3000.00
```
Metering note: they count tokens using byte-pair tokenizer compatible with our tokenizer but split multi-turn context per request; they offer both per-1M and per-request export.
Nina (Fin): quick finance checklist: 1) confirm billing entity and whether EU VAT will be applied, 2) confirm tax gross-up or vendor responsibility, 3) invoice cadence (monthly vs pref annual), 4) whether onboarding fee can be credited. we need the exact per-1M numeric value for GL mapping (looks like $18 on committed). also need vendor W-9 or equivalent.
Owen L: product follow-up 9: if TokenLedger splits multi-turn differently we could diverge. ask them for a mapping table between our request schema and their counted tokens and for a sample of hashed request IDs + token counts so we can reconcile line-by-line.
Priya S: asked vendor for: token mapping table, sample export (CSV + JSON lines), and to confirm whether their meter will accept our hashed request IDs for reconciliation. vendor replied: "we can include hashed_request_id in exports and provide per-request token counts; schema attached." asked for SOC2 + DPA too.
procure-bot: Reminder  procurement process: create PR ticket with budget code before legal review. template: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>.
Nina (Fin): finance decision rule: green if vendor accepts PO/net-30, supplies SOC2 + DPA, and credits onboarding or applies it to month-1 invoice. limit for no-legal-sign-off pilots is $100k TCV for finance-only approval.
Luke (GTM): commercial ask 9: try to get onboarding waived for pilot and a 20% pilot discount if we commit 1.5M tokens/mo. if they push back on price, request a 90-day review clause with ability to terminate.
Priya S: negotiating plan: ask for 3-month pilot (not 12), onboarding waived, PO/net-30 accepted, include hashed_request_id in exports, and SOC2/DPA. target start date 2026-03-15. I'll push vendor this afternoon.
Owen L: integration ETA: if they provide sample export and API keys by next Wed, we can wire up reconciliation + smoke tests in 10 business days. need to allocate an engineer for the reconcile job.
Nina (Fin): I'll approve contingent on their written acceptance of PO/net-30 + onboarding credit and SOC2. if TCV <= $95k and vendor meets above, finance will sign the PO. please attach vendor billing entity and tax docs to the PR.
Priya S: created procurement ticket PR-2026-211 and linked their quote. pinging vendor now. will update thread with vendor response and metering sample. :slightly_smiling_face:
Luke (GTM): noted. if we get hashed_request_id in exports we can run automated daily reconciliation and avoid surprises. good call on a shorter pilot.
Priya S: vendor responded: willing to do 3-month pilot, will waive onboarding if we commit to 3 months at 1M/mo, accepts PO/net-30 but requires billing to US subsidiary (invoice will be USD, VAT excluded). SOC2 in progress; they can provide prior audit summary this week. asking for PO creation to finalize start.
Nina (Fin): please upload their prior SOC2 summary and W-9 to PR. i'll prepare PO for $54,000 (3 months x $18k) pending docs; will hold for onboarding credit confirmation in writing.
Owen L: once we have sample export i'll run a small script to compare token counts to our internal counter and surface any >2% diffs. share the CSV format and i'll prototype.
Priya S: thanks all. closing loop: aim to have PO issued and keys in hand by 2026-03-10 to hit integration start. I'll keep updates here and share vendor docs in PR-2026-211.
